demo.title: cryptolab.sh
demo.code:
# Today's plans — entry, stop, target and size, in your own money
curl -s -H "X-API-Key: $CRYPTOLAB_KEY" \
  https://cryptolabhq.com/api/today

# What the model says about one pair
curl -s -H "X-API-Key: $CRYPTOLAB_KEY" \
  "https://cryptolabhq.com/api/predict?symbol=BTCUSDT&timeframe=1h"

# How past signals actually performed — losses included
curl -s -H "X-API-Key: $CRYPTOLAB_KEY" \
  https://cryptolabhq.com/api/signals/performance

setup: Open Account → API keys, name a key and press Create a key
Copy the key — it is shown once and never again
Send it as `X-API-Key: clab_…` (or `Authorization: Bearer clab_…`) on every request
